//: Typechecks the test *harness*, which tsconfig.json excludes.
The base config excludes `*.test.ts` and `*.testkit.ts` so that nothing test-shaped reaches
`dist/`. That is right, and it had a cost nobody had noticed: those files are then not
typechecked at all. `npm run typecheck` was clean over a `domDouble.testkit.ts` that had lost a
field declaration — every view test ran through a harness whose `textContent` returned
`undefined` where a real element returns `''`, and the only thing that caught it was a test
failing for a reason that had nothing to do with the pane it was testing.
Scope is the harness and not the tests, deliberately. A fault in a test surfaces as that test
failing, which points at the right file. A fault in the harness surfaces as whichever pane
happens to be under test failing, which points at the wrong one — and that is the whole reason
The tests themselves are run by `tsx`, whose module mode differs from this project's
(`import.meta`, `.ts` import specifiers), so checking them here would report errors about how
they are executed rather than about whether they are right. Widening this include is how that
noise gets normalised and then ignored.
